title: Updating a memory outside a set
statement: Let $s\subseteq\mathbb Z$, let $m,m':\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{BitVec}(W)$ agree at every address outside $s$, and let $a\in s$. For any word $v\in\mathrm{BitVec}(W)$, replacing the value of $m'$ at $a$ by $v$ gives a memory that still agrees with $m$ outside $s$.
hypotheses_covered: Memories $m,m'$ agree on the complement of $s$
The replacement value is a word of width $W$
